full_name: Major Jackson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Major Jackson is an associate professor of English at the University of Vermont and the author of two collections of poetry: Hoops (W. W. Norton, 2006) and Leaving Saturn (University of Georgia, 2002), which won the 2000 Cave Canem Poetry Prize and was a finalist for a National Book Critics Circle Award.
